zh: 题目按"数值对"去重，而不是按下标对计数，所以一个值出现多少次只影响它能不能和自己配对。
统计每个值的出现次数。每个合法的无序数值对都有唯一的较小端 a，只从较小端出发计数就不会重复。
对每个不同的值 a，令 b=target−a：若 a≤b、b 出现过，并且 a≠b 或 a 至少出现两次，答案加一。target 可达 5×10^9，要用 64 位整数。
en: Pairs are deduplicated by value, not counted by index, so how many times a value occurs only matters for whether it can pair with itself.
Count the occurrences of each value. Every valid unordered value pair has a unique smaller end a, so counting only from the smaller end never double-counts.
For each distinct value a, let b = target - a: if a <= b, b occurs, and either a != b or a occurs at least twice, add one to the answer. target can reach 5×10^9, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the frequencies and enumerate each distinct a; count it only when a≤target−a and the complement exists; when the two are equal, check that the frequency is at least 2.

## Proof of Correctness

Every valid unordered value pair has a unique smaller end a, so nothing is counted twice and nothing is missed; the frequency constraint guarantees exactly that two distinct indices can be chosen.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
